answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by binding each identity to a TMR-attested bus epoch, where every node must mirror its telemetry across three redundant channels before quorum admission. Colluding identities that drift past the dune of tolerated fault skew or hide behind a false ridge of stale epochs are exposed by deterministic optical link scheduling and cross-checked. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
